utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll meet you at the community center on Sunday and jump in wherever you need me most. I’ll probably be a bit late, as usual.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Dane — I’ll keep you on the list and have a spot ready for you at the community center. Just let me know when you arrive, and I’ll plug you in where it’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll message you when I’m on my way and then help wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday. If you need anything else tracked, I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. That helps a lot — I’m grateful you’re keeping track of everything.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll pass that along — bring any tools you have and, if you can, an hour to help out. Let me know if there’s anything else folks should know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, great — I’ll spread the word and remind folks to bring whatever tools they can. If I hear any new details, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Gus — the hammer and screwdriver should be enough for now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — that’s really helpful. I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll let you know the next thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just let me know when you’ve got the next fix, and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I know the next fix for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re aiming for a Saturday window that works around the school schedule — I can pin down the best time if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That helps a lot — after school or a Saturday window both work for me, and I can help coordinate around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll aim for a Saturday after-school-friendly window and circle back with the exact time soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the exact time and what needs to be brought, but Maple Street this Saturday sounds right for now.

utterances.text: Rosa: Just a quick correction: the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now, not Maple Street this Saturday. I’ll share the exact time and a bring-list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s this Saturday at the repair drive spot on Maple Street, and I’m checking what they need most right now.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what they need most, and I’ll point you to the right task.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help with the next repair—what’s on the list, and have we set the date yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I’m still able to help. I’d just like the list and the date so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still in, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. If you want, I can also round up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be really helpful. Could you remind me what needs to be brought and the exact drop-off spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you take on setup, or should I bring supplies?

utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — yes, they could still use both tools and donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good — I can help with that too, and I’ll keep an eye out for any details I might’ve missed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I really appreciate that — it helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, I’m still able to help. I’ll keep track of supplies and check in on the porch light next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard folks are meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday, and people are still gathering tools and making the fix-up list. If you want, I can ask around for the latest details on what to bring and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — that’d help. Please ask around for the latest details, and I’ll still bring the tools and check the supplies, just a bit late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and see what folks want brought and where to drop things off. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’m tracking the Maple Street spot for Saturday. If you can, please start with the porch railing and I’ll coordinate the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces too—do they still need any tools or donations for the repair drive?

utterances.text: Vik: Not yet — I’m still sorting the date, but I’ll keep everyone posted. I’m checking what they need most, especially tools or donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out too and pass along anything I hear about tools or donations.

utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. What should we line up first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to know — Sunday at the community center works. Let’s line up the tools and check what needs fixing first, so we can stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll line up the tools and make a quick list of the first repairs to check off. If you spot anything urgent, send it my way and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll pass along the tools and the hour if they can spare it. Let me know when the details firm up, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’m still in for the repair drive. Just send me the final details when they’re set, and I’ll help spread the word.
